hero_subtitle: Professional interior and exterior painting services in the Greater Montreal Area
about_text: Maxime Peinture brings 7 years of experience delivering clean, professional painting services across Montreal. We focus on quality finishes, reliable scheduling, and customer satisfaction.
testimonial_1: “The crew was professional and left the space spotless. Great finish — highly recommend.”
testimonial_2: “Very reliable scheduling and excellent workmanship. Would hire again.”
products_intro: We work with professional-grade Dulux products chosen for durability, clean finishes, and reliable performance in Montreal homes.
product_lifemaster_desc: Low-odour, low-VOC interior paint ideal for lived-in spaces where air quality and a smooth, washable finish matter.
product_lifemaster_can_desc: A durable eggshell finish that hides small surface imperfections and offers excellent touch-up capability.
product_dul7700_desc: A reliable ultra-white interior paint for ceilings and walls, giving a clean, bright result that pairs well with most decors.
product_bathroom_paint_desc: Moisture-resistant coating designed for bathrooms and humid areas, helping prevent mildew on properly prepared surfaces.
product_kitchen_bath_desc: Durable, washable paint formulated for kitchens and bathrooms where steam, moisture, and frequent cleaning are common.
product_xpert_primer_desc: High-adhesion primer that improves coverage, hides repairs, and ensures a smooth, long-lasting topcoat.
product_cover_stain_desc: A powerful stain-blocking primer used to seal water marks, smoke damage, and stubborn stains before painting.
product_mold_stop_desc: Specialized primer formulated to resist mold and mildew growth in high-humidity or problem areas.
product_metal_paint_desc: A tough, protective coating designed for metal surfaces, resisting rust, peeling, and outdoor exposure.
product_metalclad_desc: Industrial-grade enamel used on metal doors, railings, and exterior surfaces for maximum durability and corrosion resistance.
product_distinction_desc: High-quality exterior coating designed to maintain colour and sheen over time, even in harsh weather conditions.
product_xpert_paint_desc: Versatile, reliable coating suitable for a variety of surfaces, offering excellent adhesion and durability.
product_alex_caulk_desc: Flexible, paintable caulk ideal for sealing gaps around trim, windows, doors, and joints before painting.
